decisions.reason: The firm made a visible commitment by giving the coffee-based men's care series a dedicated page and line identity, and weak results can still be blamed on pandemic-related disruption, so escalation of commitment favours keeping it despite its niche positioning.
The cleansing foam was publicly announced as the newest addition to the established Sandorini series, so it is tied to a core line the firm has invested in, which makes dropping it unlikely.
